title: The Pudding
why: Visual essays that answer odd questions with data, such as how song lyrics have changed.

title: Dear Data
why: Two designers sent each other hand-drawn charts of their week on postcards for a year.

title: Spurious correlations
why: Charts of things that track each other perfectly and have nothing to do with each other.

title: Benford's law
why: In many real data sets about 30% of numbers start with 1. Auditors use this to spot fraud.

title: Citizen science
why: Zooniverse lets you classify galaxies, count penguins or transcribe old ship logs for real research.
